summary: China Sunergy is a Chinese solar cell and module manufacturer based in Nanjing, Jiangsu, that makes cells from silicon wafers and sells both domestically and internationally. The note traces its production start in 2007, its NASDAQ listing, and its 2013 opening of a manufacturing base in Turkey's Tuzla Free Trade Zone. It also notes the company's 2014 Tier 1 module supplier recognition from Bloomberg New Energy Finance.
one_line: China Sunergy is a Nanjing-based Chinese solar cell and module maker that expanded into Turkey in 2013.
key_facts: China Sunergy is a Chinese solar cell products manufacturer based in Nanjing, Jiangsu.
The company specializes in creating solar cells from silicon wafers.
China Sunergy has a major customer base in China but also sells its products internationally.
On May 17, 2007, China Sunergy began producing both monocrystalline and multicrystalline silicon solar cells.
In 2012, China Sunergy's annual production was 1 GW of solar cells and 1.2 GW of PV modules.
China Sunergy listed as a NASDAQ company in 2007.
On May 23, 2013, China Sunergy opened its first international manufacturing base in Turkey.
The Turkey factory has the biggest solar cell and module capacity in both Turkey and Europe.
CSUN is currently the only Chinese solar cell and module manufacturer with a manufacturing base in Europe.
The Turkey manufacturing base is located in the Tuzla Free Trade Zone, Istanbul.
CSUN (Turkey) was in progress of building its second Turkey factory within 2015.
On March 23, 2014, CSUN was recognized as a Tier 1 module supplier by the Bloomberg New Energy Finance (BENF) PV Module Maker Tiering System.
